audits.text:
## c36d1678a484

Source SHA256: `4a086d892d706d276c39e4e23774a30b501ff7de9d44be2c8384d5d391395756`.
All 768 sampled inputs plus three canonical pairs (771 Racket comparisons)
agree with the independent reference: expand a row to all 7 only when its
nonzero list is exactly [7]. All sampled self-checks accept.

**A3 — reproduced canonical distinctions absent from default data.** Both wrong
rules achieve 768/768 exact matches, including 256/256 in each difficulty:

* `any_seven`: expand every row containing any 7. The generator always places a
  single 7 in target rows and puts only two same-colored non-7 cells in each
  distractor row. A row with two 7s never occurs by this construction.
* `any_singleton`: expand any single-nonzero row in that cell's color. The
  generator never emits a non-7 singleton.

Canonical train[0] contains `[0,0,7,0,7,0,0]`, which must stay unchanged; the first
rival fills it. Canonical test[0] contains `[0,0,0,8,0,0,0]`, which must stay
unchanged; the second rival turns it into an all-8 row. The first rival fails all
three canonical pairs; the second fails the canonical test pair. Exact input,
expected output, and rival outputs are retained in the report. The new gate
finds six missing (difficulty, rival) distinctions; it does not certify model
behavior or claim that a finite census alone proves impossibility. Here source
inspection additionally explains why these two row types are absent.

**A4 — reproduced self-check rejection of a canonical input.** The canonical
test[0] input yields `row 0 has one non-7 cell and may look like a target`.
That is the essential negative example, not an invalid input. The self-check
incorrectly excludes a teaching distinction already present in the authority.

**A5 — reproduced override-contract defect.**
`generate(0,0,difficulty='easy',grid_h=3)` raises
`draw_int('grid_h'): override 3 outside [7, 9]`, despite advertised 3..20.

Suggested repair, left for this target's owner: admit non-7 singleton rows,
include unchanged multi-7 and 7-plus-other-color rows in ordinary lessons,
retain at least one real single-7 target, and make dimensions/counts exact.
Require Racket parity and rerun this gate after the patch. The generator's
existing explicit negative textures do not fix their absence from default
training. Unique sampled inputs were 256/256 in each band.

triage.reason: Read both target reports; preserve distinctions between 191 sampled counterexamples and zero sampled support for canonical-refuted rivals. Audit targets unchanged, separate target reproductions pending.
